items.text: Heavy rain likely till Oct 26. Avoid low roads like Vyasarpadi; report waterlogging on 1913.
Fine rice at ₹30/kg at 11 Amutham and 19 cooperative stores. Up to 5 kg per person.
New Yellow Line, Poonamallee–Vadapalani: fares ₹10–40, last train 9 pm. Change at Vadapalani.
Ayudha Pooja flights to Hyderabad hit ₹21,665. Compare govt special buses or shift dates.
Southern Railway warns against loud music or reels on trains and stations. Carry earphones.
Tambaram station: 7 of 9 new lifts built; lifts and escalator works due by December.
